commands.review_summary:
This PR narrows Mantis recommendation prompt/schema/runtime handling to Telegram, Discord, and web UI chat proof, adds non-Mantis proof-path rendering for unsupported stale recommendations, and adds focused tests.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level. Current main's prompt/schema/runtime still allow older Mantis lanes, and the PR diff narrows that behavior with focused tests.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Human review is needed for Mantis scope, real-behavior proof, and release-note ownership; ClawSweeper should not automatically repair this branch.

target.title: Clarify Mantis proof suggestion scope
target.body:
## Summary

- Scope Mantis proof suggestions to the currently useful lanes: Telegram, Discord, and web UI chat proof.
- Stop rendering copyable `@openclaw-mantis` commands for unsupported visual/native app proof such as WinUI page screenshots.
- Keep stale/unsupported recommendations useful by rendering a non-Mantis proof path suggestion instead of implying Mantis can prove the surface.

## Problem

ClawSweeper could produce a `Mantis proof suggestion` block for generic `visual_task` proof, including WinUI app/page proof. That made unsupported surfaces look like valid Mantis work even though Mantis currently has useful proof coverage only for Telegram, Discord, and web UI chat related behavior.

## Implementation

- Added an explicit `web_ui_chat_proof` Mantis scenario and narrowed structured review schema output to Telegram, Discord, and web UI chat scenarios.
- Updated the review prompt to mark WinUI, generic browser pages, dashboards, Slack desktop, terminal-only behavior, and local artifacts as non-Mantis proof paths.
- Split supported-scenario and valid-command checks so bot proof automation only plans/posts a Mantis request when both the scenario is supported and the maintainer comment is safe/copyable.
- Render unsupported stale recommendations under `Proof path suggestion` with Mantis scope plus alternatives such as maintainer screenshot/manual proof, browser/Playwright proof, Crabbox where appropriate, or local artifact proof.

## Validation

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` - passed; lockfile unchanged.
- `pnpm run build:all` - passed.
- `node --test test\review-prompt-policy.test.ts test\proof-nudge-policy.test.ts` - passed, 44/44.
- `pnpm run lint:src` - passed.
- `pnpm run lint:scripts` - passed.
- `git diff --check` - passed.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src\clawsweeper.ts test\proof-nudge-policy.test.ts test\review-prompt-policy.test.ts schema\clawsweeper-decision.schema.json` - passed.
- `pnpm run test:unit` - ran on Windows; 668/677 passed, 1 skipped. The 8 failures are unrelated local Windows environment/line-ending failures: four `dispatch-receipt-owner` bash tests and one `sweep-workflow` bash test fail because this host's WSL relay cannot exec `/bin/bash`, two `local-range-review` tests miss their fake-codex sentinel, and `pages-workflow` is CRLF-sensitive against a workflow fixture. The Mantis/prompt tests passed in this run.

## Proof

Focused tests cover:

- Telegram suggestions still render a copyable `@openclaw-mantis telegram desktop proof:` PR comment.
- Discord suggestions still render a copyable `@openclaw-mantis discord status reactions proof:` PR comment.
- Web UI chat suggestions render a copyable `@openclaw-mantis web UI chat proof:` PR comment.
- WinUI/non-chat `visual_task` suggestions do not render a `Mantis proof suggestion` section or `@openclaw-mantis visual task` command, and instead render scoped non-Mantis proof guidance.
- Bot-proof handling falls back to maintainer-decision handling when a supported scenario has an invalid/ambiguous Mantis command.

Codex review closeout:

- Command: `codex review -c service_tier='"fast"' --base origin/main`.
- First review finding accepted: `[P2] Fall back when the Mantis command is invalid`; fixed by requiring `hasDispatchableMantisScenario` to validate both supported scenario and safe maintainer comment.
- Reran focused proof after the fix: `node --test test\review-prompt-policy.test.ts test\proof-nudge-policy.test.ts` passed, 44/44.
- Final Codex review result: `No actionable correctness issues were found in the diff. The focused build and relevant unit tests passed during review.`

## Risks / Rollout

- Existing stored reports with `visual_task` or `slack_desktop_smoke` remain parseable for compatibility, but no longer dispatch or render as copyable Mantis requests.
- Maintainers may see a broader `Proof path suggestion` section for old unsupported recommendations; that is intentional and should reduce false Mantis routing.
- No workflow files or security-sensitive behavior were changed.

## Links

- Related broader proof-attestation discussion: #421. This PR is intentionally limited to Mantis suggestion scope and does not add Mantis capabilities.
